content: Perform a comprehensive first pass of the text to identify all unique entities (organizations, locations, people) before attempting to define the relationships between them.
Maintain a strict 1:1 mapping between each distinct textual claim and its corresponding RDF triple (Subject -> Predicate -> Object) to maximize precision and F1 scores.
Map extracted entities and relations to standardized identifiers (e.g., Wikidata Q-ids for entities and P-ids for properties) to ensure semantic interoperability.

Distinguish between semantically similar but distinct relations (e.g., 'published by' vs 'owned by') by assigning them to separate, specific predicates to ensure the granularity of the knowledge graph matches the source text.
